facts.fact: Huawei's case study says NOSi, Cabo Verde's Operational Information Society Nucleus, was responsible for service development and operation and maintenance of the eGovernment system and developed more than 150 websites and 77 types of eGovernment software; no date is given for the event, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: NOSi eGovernment software and websites (incl. IGRP, SIS)

facts.fact: Huawei's case study says NOSi built eGovernment software for all government departments, schools, hospitals and state-owned enterprises and provided data centre hosting; no date is given for the event, so the document's published date is used.
